# Dima Mikheiev

> Dima Mikheiev is an AI Solutions Architect and Fractional Head of AI who helps companies decide where AI can create real business value, then leads and builds systems that make it work in practice.

## Site

- [Home](https://mikheiev.com/): overview of Dima Mikheiev, services, selected work, proof points, portfolio, and contact links.

## Blog

- [Turning Documents Into Maps with RAG and Databricks](https://mikheiev.com/blog/turning-documents-into-maps-with-rag-and-databricks/): article about turning books into geographic data with RAG, GeoNames, and Databricks, and validating AI-generated data.
- [Everyone Wants an AI Prediction. Who Checks the Data Behind It?](https://mikheiev.com/blog/everyone-wants-an-ai-prediction-who-checks-the-data-behind-it/): article about an AWS car price prediction system, nearest-neighbor matching, data quality, and showing the evidence behind predictions.
- [AI Was Supposed to Make Work Easier](https://mikheiev.com/blog/ai-was-supposed-to-make-work-easier/): article about AI video production workflows, using Notion as a single interface, and keeping specialized tools behind the scenes.
- [I Built an AI Content System for a Beauty Brand](https://mikheiev.com/blog/AI-Content-System-for-a-Beauty-Brand/): article about building an AI content system for a beauty and wellness brand, with lessons on team adoption, workflow design, brand context, and where human review still matters.

## Primary Positioning

Dima helps companies choose the right AI direction, design architecture, build systems, and make sure those systems are useful to the team.

## Services

- Fractional Head of AI: senior AI direction, project prioritization, system connection strategy, and team adoption guidance.
- Marketing Automation: AI systems for content creation, campaign management, product data workflows, and repetitive-task automation.
- AI Video & Content: systems using AI image, video, voice, and avatars to create content at scale.

## Proof Points

- 15+ years in technology.
- Upwork Top Rated Plus.
- YouTube Shorts channel reached 1,000+ subscribers with $0 spent on ads.

## Selected Work

- [AI-Powered Used Car Price Prediction Platform on AWS](https://mikheiev.com/ai-powered-used-car-price-prediction-platform-on-aws/): Automated machine learning system for predicting second-hand car prices, built on AWS.
- [AI-Powered Invoice Processing at Scale on Azure](https://mikheiev.com/ai-powered-invoice-processing-at-scale-on-azure/): Designed and built a scalable Azure-based system for processing large volumes of PDF invoices and converting them into structured XML.
- [Automated Video Production Pipeline With Characters](https://mikheiev.com/automated-video-production-pipeline-with-characters/): n8n-powered AI video generation system with consistent characters, automated editing, voice synthesis, and final assembly.
- [Automated Content System for Beauty and Wellness Brands](https://mikheiev.com/automated-content-system-for-beauty-and-wellness-brands/): Notion, Hermes, and Make.com pipeline for branded product imagery and marketing assets.
- [Automated AI Content Production for Pinterest](https://mikheiev.com/automated-ai-content-production-for-pinterest/): n8n and Notion workflow for branded infographics, human review, and Pinterest publishing.
- [AI Buyer Persona Agents for Product Research](https://mikheiev.com/ai-buyer-persona-agents-for-product-research/): buyer persona agents for product feedback, positioning, messaging, and packaging ideas.
- [AI Powered Video Pipeline](https://mikheiev.com/ai-powered-video-pipeline-faceless-content-production-system/): automated faceless video production and publishing system for YouTube and TikTok.
- [AI Agent for lead generation](https://mikheiev.com/ai-agent-for-lead-generation/): autonomous lead research, qualification, outreach, and CRM workflow using n8n and OpenClaw.
- [Auto-Reply System for GoHighLevel](https://mikheiev.com/auto-reply-system-for-gohighlevel-with-whatsapp/): WhatsApp and SMS auto-reply automation using n8n, Redis, Claude, and GoHighLevel.
- [AI Content Marketing Automation](https://mikheiev.com/ai-content-marketing-automation/): multi-platform social publishing system with AI agents, avatar video production, automated scheduling, and organic lead generation workflows.
- [Etsy Competitor Research Automation](https://mikheiev.com/etsy-competitor-research-automation-apify-playwright-claude-code/): Etsy competitor research pipeline using Apify, Playwright, Claude Code, and eRank.
